mortgageTransition.citation: FHFA, Monthly Interest Rate Survey (MIRS), MIRS Transition Index Data File, https://www.fhfa.gov/document/d/mirs/mirs-historical-data-file (data/research/macro/series/mirs-transition-index.csv; sha256 in receipts.json). This product uses FHFA data but is neither endorsed nor certified by FHFA.
mortgageTransition.estimatedFrom: FHFA calls the index "a version of Freddie Mac's 30-year" survey "that adjusts for differences between the two", says "It is not a replacement for PMMS" and that it "is intended to be used in lieu of the discontinued index for currently outstanding loans"; it stands in for the discontinued monthly 30-year rate (acting CTO ruling, Oct 20). FHFA lists each value under the month it is released ("September 2026: 6.48"); each is kept here under the month two before its release, the alignment that best matches the 30-year rate it adjusts (mean difference -0.026 point, standard deviation 0.085, over 89 months, against 0.421 when kept under the release month). Months not yet covered read the 10-year Treasury plus the sourced spread.
